title: Require capture tokens for blocking corrections to prove policy
context: Constitution policy candidates must have human_confirmed provenance (bootstrap.ts). Un-token'd corrections are authorship-stamped as agent_recorded and capped at warning severity, preventing them from proving policy. The test was failing because it expected blocking but got warning. Tests must model the real workflow.
decision: Conduct a capture interview and pass the resulting capture_token when recording blocking corrections intended as policy candidates. This ensures testimony is human-confirmed before becoming policy evidence.
consequences: Blocking corrections require capture tokens to prove policy eligibility
Un-token'd corrections cap at warning and cannot form basis of policy
Enforces human authority boundary for all policy evidence in constitution
Tests model real workflow: capture interview, then record with token
alternatives_rejected: Relax the regex assertion to accept warning-severity corrections (would allow policy minting from un-confirmed testimony)
Allow un-token'd corrections to prove policy (violates human_confirmed requirement)

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Relax the regex assertion to accept warning-severity corrections (would allow policy minting from un-confirmed testimony)
